name: MQTT discovery
description: Tasmota, ESPHome, Shelly and other devices that announce themselves for Home Assistant, without Home Assistant.
author: LocalAssistant

connection.description: Devices that support Home Assistant's MQTT discovery publish their description on the MQTT broker. Turn discovery on in each device (Tasmota: SetOption19 off and the Home Assistant integration on; ESPHome: the mqtt component), and they show up here on their own.
connection.connected: Switches, lights, locks, fans, buttons, covers, door and window sensors, other sensors and thermostats show up here on their own.

fields.name: prefix
fields.label: Discovery prefix
fields.message: Type the discovery prefix, homeassistant unless you changed it.
